tool: scripts/bench_detector_memory.py 20000 (tracemalloc; Python heap growth only, excludes interpreter baseline and librdkafka buffers)
hardware: x86_64 Linux container; not the target Mac
input: 20,000 vehicles x 3 realistic canonical events (29 fields), 2 % with a DTC, 20 tenants

before.note: full last event kept per vehicle (3.6 KB of it), eager empty DTC deque (760 B), per-vehicle tenant-id strings

after.change: keep only the 6 fields the snapshot reports; create the DTC window lazily; intern tenant ids

why: M14 100K-vehicle load test: the detector container hit its 512 MB limit and was OOM-killed 25 times in 5 minutes (dmesg: 'Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process ... prognos-detecto ... anon-rss:521896kB'), processing ~2.2K of 10K msg/s
